definitions.explanation: A feeling of deep unhappiness or distress.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}い{悲|かな}しみに{暮|く}れる。
examples.english: To be overcome with deep grief.

examples.japanese: {悲|かな}しみを{乗|の}り{越|こ}える。
{悲|かな}しみが{癒|い}えるには{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time for grief to heal.

notes:
{悲|かな}しみ is the noun form of the i-adjective {悲|かな}しい (sad), formed by replacing い with み. It refers to the feeling or state of sadness itself, ranging from mild unhappiness to deep grief.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {悲|かな}しみに{暮|く}れる: to be stricken with grief
- {悲|かな}しみを{乗|の}り{越|こ}える: to overcome sadness
- {悲|かな}しみに{沈|しず}む: to sink into sorrow
- {深|ふか}い{悲|かな}しみ: deep grief/sorrow

WORD FAMILY:
- {悲|かな}しい: sad (i-adjective)
- {悲|かな}しむ: to grieve, to feel sad (verb)
- {悲|かな}しげ: looking sad (na-adjective, literary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悲哀|ひあい}: sorrow, pathos (more literary/formal)
- {哀|かな}しみ: same word, alternate kanji (less common)
